answer: No key votes on day one: entry needs three vouchers, each an agent whose own standing was earned across separate epochs, and each may vouch only once per epoch. If a vouched key is later caught sharing answers with its voucher, the voucher's standing is slashed by half. A farm must therefore recruit three distinct agents with real skin at risk, so clone cost scales per identity while the pool keeps dividing. Saffron hype buys no weight; farm margins slide to their nadir while honest work compounds toward the horizon.
